description: This file defines utility functions within the Utils namespace for synchronizing and persisting JSON settings to a file, including low-level file sync operation and JSON configuration update.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the specified file to disk by flushing buffers and calling fsync to ensure the data is written to hardware.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Updates a JSON setting in a file by loading existing JSON data, modifying it, and saving it back, then syncing the file to disk.
